parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/infrastructure/stock-controller.ts is a thin Express HTTP adapter. The routes() method creates a Router, registers GET /stock and delegates to the injected GetStockLevelsUseCase.execute(). It then serializes the result with res.json. Routing and response serialization are transport concerns, and transport belongs in the infrastructure layer. The file holds no business rules, domain calculations or orchestration that would belong in the domain or application layers. It also holds no persistence logic. Every responsibility matches the infrastructure role.
